html:
Hanoi Fireworks Festival takes place on the occasion of April 30 – May 1, this is an occasion to celebrate the 50th anniversary of the Liberation of the South and the reunification of the country. The fireworks festival has a low-altitude and pyrotechnic display at the F1 racing track, Phu Do ward, Nam Tu Liem district.

The live TV program “Vang mai khuc khai hoan” will display high-altitude and low-altitude fireworks at the multi-purpose stage, taking place at Thong Nhat park, expected time from 21:45 to 22:00 on April 27.

Hanoi Fireworks display locations on the occasion of April 30 – May 1

At public locations

The fireworks display location is a multi-purpose stage located close to the edge of Bay Mau Lake, about 300 m from the park gate on Le Duan street. The best place to watch the fireworks is in the park, a spacious, airy space and completely free for visitors to admire the fireworks on the occasion.

Visitors from Tran Nhan Tong and Nguyen Dinh Chieu streets will enjoy beautiful fireworks because they are very close to the shooting location. On weekends, the walking street in the Park will not have fences so that people and tourists can easily walk around and watch the fireworks.

In addition, people and tourists can also admire the fireworks display on Le Duan, Dai Co Viet, Dao Duy Anh, Xa Dan streets or around Thien Quang lake, or apartment buildings near the shooting location, especially at Prime Center (Quang Trung street), Ocean Park (Dao Duy Anh street), Hoa Phat Tower (Giai Phong street), Bach Khoa University… tourists will enjoy the full beauty of the fireworks.

Watching fireworks on April 30 at coffee shops

There are coffee shops near Thong Nhat Park and on high floors where visitors can sip coffee while watching beautiful fireworks displays such as Kitsune Coffee at 378 Le Duan (11th floor), Aries Rooftop Coffee at 8 O Cho Dua (9th floor) or Helios Skyview at 150 Ton Duc Thang (8th floor)…

The Sipping Bar Waterfront is a coffee shop overlooking the lake, with a beautiful view, so during the holidays, seats are arranged both indoors and outdoors. Especially on the occasion of fireworks, the shop often offers free parking for visitors, visitors can buy coffee and find the best spot to watch the fireworks.

On Nguyen Dinh Chieu Street, there are many coffee shops with beautiful views such as: Joah, An Kinh Bac, Hanoian, Industry, Shinee, 80 plus, Renée… however, the view from the shops here will not be as beautiful as the shops near Thong Nhat Park, because there are green branches blocking the view.

So if you are looking for a holiday during the 30/4 – 1/5 holiday, sign up for a Hanoi tour to admire the brilliant fireworks, and enjoy delicious dishes with the rich flavor of Hanoi right on the walking street, Hoan Kiem Lake, while enjoying the poetic scenery, or enjoy a cup of coffee while watching the brilliant fireworks during the holiday.

In addition, visitors should visit Hanoi during the blooming lily season, visitors will encounter cars full of flowers, weaving through every street corner, exuding a sweet fragrance in the wind.

That image not only gives you a picture of Hanoi’s approaching summer, and the most beautiful lily season is in April, wallflowers are grown in the suburbs of Hanoi such as Tay Tuu, Me Linh, Dan Phuong… after the flowers are harvested, people often bring them to Hanoi to sell or traders return and distribute them to the flower markets that fill Hanoi.

The flowers usually bloom for 3 weeks, but are most beautiful in mid-April, the lily flower exudes a sweet fragrance, suitable for all spaces, this flower is often used to decorate the living room, or as a gift in early summer.

Besides, in the center of Hanoi, along the streets full of tamarind leaves, along the tamarind tree roots are changing leaves spread out like a carpet, especially on the streets such as: Tran Hung Dao, Ly Thuong Kiet, Phan Dinh Phung, Dien Bien Phu…

It can be said that the beauty of the lily flower, and the season of tamarind leaves changing like a signal that summer has come, creating a beautiful summer picture, bringing you the most enjoyable vacation.
